jwessels530: Ulrich Jwessels came up the line with a dented harmonica and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. The transfer made Ulrich Jwessels a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
lagbagdotzip: Severin Lagbagdotzip came up the line with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Severin Lagbagdotzip fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Quentin "Shadow" Danny, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
pgallo102: Ulrich Pgallo was a tram conductor in Rosenau until the posters went up. He came to S-F5 with a tin whistle, and within a day the whole squad knew that he is always the first one awake. The transfer made Ulrich Pgallo a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
Ulrich Pgallo wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
